caption: Figure 9.3: Protection Hook sequence chart The sequence shows the flow of control if a protection error occurs. Depending on the return values of the ProtectionHook, either the faulty Task/ISR is forcibly terminated or the OS-Application is forcibly terminated or the system is shut down. If the action is to terminate the faulty OS-Application an option is to start afterwards the restart task, which can do a cleanup, etc.
